logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting job illustration for the pump-module qualification report: a side-view technical illustration of a water-reclamation transfer loop acceptance test rig. A single pump module sits on a skid with suction and discharge piping, an isolation valve, a flow meter and a head gauge, discharging toward a clarifier tank in the background. A technician with a clipboard logs the acceptance run while an energy readout panel displays a kWh counter. Four candidate modules on pallets wait at the side of the rig. Flat engineering-manual style, muted blue and gray palette with a #1B6CA8 accent, no lettering or numerals required, single centered composition suitable for a decision-report figure box.
